verified_facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch is located on a wildlife sanctuary above the town of Jackson.

verified_facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch sits atop East Gros Ventre Butte.

verified_facts.text: The former open range around the ranch is protected in perpetuity as nearly 1,000 acres of open space.
verified_facts.excerpt: What was once open range is now protected in perpetuity as nearly 1,000 acres of open space, and is home to more than 100 species of birds and wildlife.

verified_facts.text: The ranch's location gives it views of the Teton Mountain Range, including the Grand Teton.
verified_facts.excerpt: Because of the unique location, it has the most spectacular views of the Teton Mountain Range, including the world famous Grand Teton.

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose from Inn Rooms, Studios, Suites, Townhomes or Mountain Villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury ranch provides guests with a choice of Inn Rooms, Studios, Suites, Townhomes or Mountain Villas.

verified_facts.text: All Mountain Villas include four bedrooms, four baths, a full kitchen, dining room, living room and fireplaces throughout.
verified_facts.excerpt: All include 4 bedrooms, 4 baths, full kitchen, dining room, living room, and fireplaces throughout.

verified_facts.text: The Mountain Villas are uniquely furnished by each owner in a cozy, western style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uniquely furnished by each owner, they display a cozy, western atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Room amenities include a wood-burning fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wood-burning fireplace

verified_facts.text: The units do not have air conditioning.
verified_facts.excerpt: While we do not have A/C in our units similar to most hotels and resorts in Jackson, guests can enjoy the fresh cool mountain breeze

verified_facts.text: The ranch has a seasonal outdoor heated pool.

verified_facts.excerpt: Roast marshmallows over our open fire-pit and take in the breath-taking sunset over the Tetons.

verified_facts.text: The Wilderness Adventure Spa environment is cell phone free.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa is a peaceful place of refuge. Our environment is cell phone free so that you may leave feeling stress free!

verified_facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate your skin and protect if from the dry, high-altitude air with the right facial for your skincare needs.

verified_facts.excerpt: Start with a mineral scrub to heal dry climate skin with mud bubbling on your spine. After rinsing, we follow with a White Pine and Basil full body massage.
